name: TC-SUT-02: wizard does not advance past Step 1 without a brand selected on Sell Used Trucks
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UsedTruck/SellUsedTrucks.cy.js#UsedTruck - SellUsedTrucks [en] — Sell Used Trucks TC-SUT-02: wizard does not advance past Step 1 without a brand selected on Sell Used Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-SUT-02
**Title:** Wizard does not advance past Step 1 without a brand selected on Sell Used Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Click Next on Step 1 without picking a truck brand.

**Expected Result:**
The wizard stays on Step 1 — the Brands field is still shown and Model (Step 2) never appears.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Sell Used Trucks page
2. Click Next without selecting a brand
3. Verify the wizard remains on Step 1
